title: Uniqueness of the supplied scalar adjunction
statement: Let C, R, Rprime, phi and S be as in the scalar system models [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. The derived adjunction supplied by S is equal to sheafScalarDerivedAdjunction phi S.model, the canonical scalar adjunction [lem-sfb-divisible-extension-derived-reduction].

source.place: clause (2), scalar extension and finite evaluation

proof.text: The section equation identifies the ordinary units pointwise: the model object equality and its inverse cancel. Adjunction.ext identifies the ordinary adjunctions.
On a K-flat representative transpose_model at the identity and the canonical derived unit equation identify the derived units after an invertible counit comparison. Cancel this comparison.

Choose a K-flat resolution and use naturality to extend unit equality to every complex. Essential surjectivity of Q extends it to every derived object. Adjunction.ext then identifies the derived adjunctions.
